appDescription: An in-car AI co-pilot that plans EV charging and rest stops, keeps the parked cabin safe for pets and resting passengers, and explains vehicle warnings using live vehicle data.

function.name: PLAN_EV_TRIP
function.description: Plan a trip to a destination that combines EV charging stops and passenger rest breaks based on the current battery level.

companions.description: Who is travelling with the driver.

function.name: START_CARE_MODE
function.description: Keep the parked cabin at a comfortable temperature for a pet left inside or for a short rest, and show a status screen.

function.name: DIAGNOSE_VEHICLE
function.description: Explain a dashboard warning light or a vehicle symptom in plain language using live vehicle data and suggest what to do next.

symptom.description: The warning light or symptom described by the user.
